blind.description: A stylized fantasy architectural flying buttress consisting of a tall rectangular pillar with a decorative cracked capital and an embossed horned demon face, joined to an arched masonry strut lined with golden spikes/horns along its spine that slopes down to a stepped square foot. The model is solid, manifold, and finished in warm brown stone with bronze/gold edge highlights and trims. Both feet sit flat directly on the ground with integrated stepped plinths, with no floating parts or particle effects.
blind.from_above: A straight strip showing the square cracked top of the main pillar on the right, connected via an arched bridge topped with five pointed golden spikes in a row down to a smaller stepped square foot on the left.
blind.height_vs_figure: The top of the pillar stands roughly 6.5 to 7 feet tall (slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure), and spans about 5 to 6 feet in length across the arch.

notes: footprint proportion 2.79x off the catalog (9.0 x 2.4 ft)
